recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13185; external Immunization Incubator artifacts or the generic search-page example should be handled by their owning issue or repository if future cleanup is desired.
issue_request: FHIR-13185 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It requested that Immunization.vaccinationProtocol.seriesDoses, ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.doseNumber, and ImmunizationRecommendation.recommendation.protocol.doseSequence not be limited to positiveInt because booster and recurring-dose labels can be non-numeric; the approved direction was integer or string with an integer preference, and comments also raised removing related search parameters.
initial_application: Source history shows b294e9e7f9239a04662837e18dfffefbe41d5ecb applying the original string-option work to older immunization recommendation/evaluation sources, and R4 cross-version history shows the affected immunization dose fields as positiveInt|string choices. A later focused issue, FHIR-19340, removed unnecessary ImmunizationRecommendation dose search parameters in 760cdc540d095f4d73ccc47fc91be0098ec53076.
additional_context: Later final PHER decisions intentionally changed the same datatype family: FHIR-25277 made doseNumber and seriesDoses string-only for R5, and FHIR-44982 made the current active Immunization fields CodeableConcept for R6 so coded concepts or free text can be used. Both FHIR-25277 and FHIR-44982 are already represented on the combined branch. Current fhir.ini lists Immunization as an active core resource, while ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation are no longer active core resources and are linked externally from the resource guide.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active Immunization StructureDefinition and example source use CodeableConcept for protocolApplied.doseNumber and protocolApplied.seriesDoses, and targeted searches found no active core doseNumber, seriesDoses, or doseSequence search parameter definitions to remove. Reverting to positiveInt|string or restoring the older integer-preference comments would contradict later final decisions.
